headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 win over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Spencer Arrighetti earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 5 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several players placed on the injured list. The Colorado Rockies' Mickey Moniak has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis. The San Francisco Giants' Jung Hoo Lee has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 19, 2026, with a mid-back strain. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Detroit Tigers' Burch Smith, the Cincinnati Reds' Ke'Bryan Hayes, the Los Angeles Angels' Yoán Moncada, and the Los Angeles Angels' Yusei Kikuchi.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Miami Marlins acquiring outfielder Rece Hinds in a trade with the Cincinnati Reds. The Tampa Bay Rays traded left-hander Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for third baseman Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded left-hander Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash. The Athletics traded center fielder Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for left-hander Jackson Nove.

top_news.title: **Guardians Shut Down Phillies in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 1-0 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of shutout baseball. Kyle Manzardo led the Guardians' offense with a solo home run in the game.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Yankees 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-2, securing a win in their matchup. Kevin Gausman earned the win for the Blue Jays, while Louis Varland recorded the save.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Mickey Moniak on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Mickey Moniak has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis.

top_news.title: **Marlins Acquire Hinds in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins have acquired outfielder Rece Hinds in a trade with the Cincinnati Reds. Hinds joins the Marlins in exchange for right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley.
